messages:
sarah-ops: Heads up—users in APAC reporting intermittent 503s on model-proxy. I see a spike in mTLS handshake failures around 08:22:10 ap-southeast-1.

maria-infra: grabbing logs now. can you paste an example error?

sarah-ops: paste from proxy logs: 
```
2026-03-22T08:22:09Z proxy[fwk]: tls_handshake_error: remote error: tls: unknown certificate
caused_by: keystore unwrap failed: kms.DecryptAccessDenied: Access denied for role arn:aws:iam::111:role/proxy-keystore-apac
```

raj-sec: hmm KMS Decrypt denied. Did we push the RBAC tighten yesterday? @maria-infra any recent IAM changes targeted at apac? :thinking_face:

maria-infra: yes there was a scoped policy change to reduce cross-account kms:Decrypt surface for several roles, landed in PR #4123 at 07:50. I rolled the policy in incrementally to apac.

jon-oncall: paging through the rotator: keystore fetches are failing which blocks mTLS client cert validation. traffic fallback is returning 503s. I'm going to pause the rollout for the remaining regions.

sarah-ops: marking incident, raising priority. can we confirm scope of hosts impacted?

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-APAC-MTLS (priority P1) — responders: jon-oncall, maria-infra, raj-sec

maria-infra: quick grep across proxies shows ~14% of ingress servers in ap-southeast-1 hit repeated kms:DecryptAccessDenied between 08:21–08:30. other regions unaffected.

raj-sec: please dump CloudTrail KMS events for the role and time range and share. need to verify whether the deny is from IAM or a permissions boundary. also pull agent audit logs for the proxy service (token, principal) — suspect role binding changed.

sarah-ops: sharing KMS snippet: 
```
EventTime: 2026-03-22T08:22:09Z
EventName: Decrypt
Principal: arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/proxy-keystore-apac/i-0a1b2c
ResponseElements: {"ErrorCode":"AccessDenied"}
```

jon-oncall: confirmed, Decrypt call returned AccessDenied. Role no longer allowed. I can revert the policy but want a safer short-term mitigation: enable regional fallback to cached keystore entries for 10m and return cached certs while we restore KMS access. Can someone flip cache-serve?

maria-infra: I can toggle the cache flag on the proxy fleet via feature-flag service: `ff toggle proxy.keystore.cache.apac true`. Doing it now.

sarah-ops: thanks. after toggling cached responses, 503s dropped to ~1% in last 3 minutes. users recovering. :thumbsup:

raj-sec: we still need root cause. @maria-infra which exact policy block removed kms:Decrypt? paste the policy diff.

maria-infra: diff from PR #4123 (excerpt): 
```
-    "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
-    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111:key/keystore",
+    "NotAction": ["kms:List*","kms:Describe*"],
+    "Effect": "Deny",
```

maria-infra: tl;dr: we applied a deny-by-default with exclusions but missed the proxy-keystore role in the allow-list. my bad.

raj-sec: that explains it. Deny policies take precedence. Action items: 1) revert/patch policy to explicitly allow proxy-keystore Decrypt for apac 2) add preflight tests to policy rollout pipeline (simulate Decrypt calls) 3) extend KMS audit forwarding to SIEM for immediate alerting 4) update incident runbook to include cache-flip step.

jon-oncall: I'm applying the temporary policy patch to re-allow kms:Decrypt for `proxy-keystore-apac` and will monitor. Patching now.

infra-bot: Deploy of policy patch started — change id: patch-20260322-01

jon-oncall: patch applied, KMS Decrypts now succeeding, keystore unwraps happy, mTLS handshakes back to normal. rolling incident to monitoring.

sarah-ops: thanks team. postmortem notes to include: missed role in allow-list, deny-style policy without exhaustive allowlist, lack of policy preflight test, cache-flip mitigation worked.

raj-sec: also recommend: stronger audit link between IAM change PRs and KMS principal entitlement checks, and a rule in CI that runs a dry-run KMS Decrypt with the affected role (via sts:AssumeRole test account). I'll open a proposal doc.

maria-infra: opening followups: infra-2462 (add preflight Decrypt simulation), infra-2463 (policy rollout canary + checklist), infra-2464 (extend audit forwarding of CloudTrail KMS events to SIEM).

sarah-ops: assigning owners: maria -> infra-2462+2463, raj -> infra-2464, jon -> update runbook with cache-flip steps. ETA 1 week for fixes?

jon-oncall: ETA Ack. I'll also add a short playbook snippet: 
```
1) ff toggle proxy.keystore.cache.apac true
2) confirm cached serving: /_health/keystore
3) revert policy or apply patch
4) monitor KMS Decrypt metrics for 30m
```

sec-bot: FYI — linked playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/mTLS-keystore-fallback

sarah-ops: closing incident thread, will capture full writeup in postmortem doc. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
